tools.name: value_payment_stream
tools.description: Present value of a structured settlement, annuity or lottery payment stream at typical buyer discount rates (8% to 18%), and, if a lump-sum offer is given, the effective discount rate that offer implies, the cents on the dollar, and whether it sits in the typical range. With targetAmount, also prices a partial sale (sell only enough payments to raise that amount and keep the rest). Use when someone asks what their payments are worth, whether an offer is fair, or what selling part of their payments would cost.

payment.description: Amount of each payment in US dollars

count.description: Number of payments left (give this, or years and/or months)

years.description: Years of payments left (alternative to count)

months.description: Extra months of payments left (used with years)

startsInMonths.description: Months until the first payment, if the payments have not started yet (default 0)

annualIncreasePct.description: Yearly step-up in the payment, in percent (for example 3 for 3% a year)

lifeContingent.description: true if the payments stop at the recipient's death

offer.description: Lump sum a buyer has offered for these payments, in US dollars (optional)

targetAmount.description: Lump sum wanted from a PARTIAL sale, in US dollars (optional). Returns partial_sale: what it costs to raise this amount by selling the next payments in full, or a slice of every payment, at 8%, 13% and 18%.

tools.name: state_transfer_rules
tools.description: A US state's Structured Settlement Protection Act rules for selling settlement payments: disclosure waiting period, independent professional advice rule, cancellation right, which court approves, statute citation, notable quirks and primary sources. Verified against the statute text.

state.description: State name or slug, for example "Texas" or "north-carolina"

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: All 50 states plus DC with each one's disclosure waiting period, whether independent advice is required, and the statute citation. Use to compare states.

tools.name: discount_rate_index
tools.description: The public benchmark rates that govern structured settlement and annuity sales this month: the IRS applicable federal rates every disclosure must use, the prime rate, the statutory rate caps (North Carolina, Michigan, Nebraska) and the typical range of buyer discount rates, each with its primary source and date.
